title: CacheGraft: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Latent-Space Document Enrichment
abstract: arXiv:2611.07393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work in machine learning has demonstrated that transformer-based language model agents can communicate state not only through text, but also directly in latent space via key-value (KV) caches. In this paper, we argue that such cache-to-cache translation can provide utility beyond the original motivating application of real-time agent communication and can instead be utilized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Building on the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework, our proposed system CacheGraft encodes each corpus passage offline into a fused KV cache representation between a larger sharer model (4B parameters in our experiments) and a smaller receiver model (0.6B parameters) such that this cache can be injected into the receiver at query time with no need for the larger model. translated_title: CacheGraft：通过潜空间文档增强来提升检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 机器学习领域的最新研究表明，基于Transformer的语言模型代理不仅可以直接通过文本进行通信，还可以在潜空间中通过键值（KV）缓存直接进行通信。在本文中，我们提出这种缓存到缓存的翻译技术可以提供超越其实时代理通信这一最初应用场景的实用价值，并可用于检索增强生成（RAG）。基于缓存到缓存（C2C）融合框架，我们提出的系统CacheGraft将每个语料库段落离线编码为较大共享模型（实验中为4B参数）和较小接收模型（0.6B参数）之间的融合KV缓存表示，使得该缓存可以在查询时注入到接收模型中，而无需较大模型。在五个问答基准测试和两个独立本地运行的评估器上，CacheGraft在29个案例中（摘要在此处被截断）相比纯文本接收模型基线提升了答案质量。
tldr: CacheGraft基于缓存到缓存（C2C）融合框架，将语料库段落离线编码为潜空间KV缓存表示，在查询时直接注入小模型，无需大模型参与即可增强检索增强生成（RAG）的答案质量。
en_tdlr: CacheGraft leverages the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework to encode corpus passages offline into latent-space KV cache representations that can be injected into a smaller model at query time, enhancing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answer quality without requiring the larger model.
